digest.lead: The big story today is Claude Code v2.1.90's release with '/powerup' interactive learning features, addressing developer onboarding challenges.
digest.summary: The community is building impressive monitoring tools for Claude agents, while secondary market activity suggests growing enterprise interest in Anthropic versus OpenAI.

stories.headline: Secondary Market Signals Growing Anthropic Demand Over OpenAI
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports that OpenAI demand is declining on secondary markets while Anthropic's Claude is seeing increased investor interest [1]. The shift reflects changing market sentiment around AI capabilities and enterprise adoption patterns.
key_points: OpenAI shares losing favor among secondary market investors
Anthropic positioned as the rising alternative in enterprise AI
stories.impact: Enterprise teams and investors are reassessing AI provider strategies, potentially accelerating Claude adoption in production environments.

sources.title: OpenAI demand sinks on secondary market as Anthropic runs hot

stories.headline: Claude Code v2.1.90 Introduces Interactive Learning with '/powerup' Command
stories.summary: The latest Claude Code update adds '/powerup' interactive lessons with animated demos to help developers learn features hands-on [1]. The release also includes improved offline marketplace caching and fixes for rate-limit dialog crashes that were disrupting coding sessions [1].
key_points: New '/powerup' command provides interactive tutorials with visual demonstrations
Enhanced offline support with CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE environment variable
Fixed critical rate-limit dialog loop that could crash development sessions
stories.impact: Developers new to Claude Code will have a smoother onboarding experience, while existing users benefit from more stable offline development workflows.

stories.headline: Cowork Dispatch Message Delivery Fixed in v2.1.87
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.87 resolved a critical bug preventing message delivery in Cowork Dispatch, the team collaboration feature [1].
stories.impact: Development teams using Claude Code's collaborative features can now communicate reliably during pair programming and code review sessions.

stories.headline: Real-Time Dashboard Tool Emerges for Claude Code Agent Teams
stories.summary: A new open-source project called 'agents-observe' provides real-time monitoring dashboards for Claude Code agent teams, gaining significant community attention [1]. The tool addresses the growing need for visibility into multi-agent development workflows.
key_points: Open-source dashboard for monitoring Claude Code agent team activities
Strong community response with 71 upvotes on Hacker News
stories.impact: Development teams managing multiple Claude Code agents now have better visibility into their automated workflows, improving debugging and performance optimization.

sources.title: Show HN: Real-time dashboard for Claude Code agent teams

stories.headline: Use /powerup command to learn Claude Code features interactively
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.90 introduced the /powerup command that provides interactive lessons with animated demos to help you learn Claude Code features. This is particularly useful for new users who want to quickly understand the tool's capabilities through hands-on tutorials.
actionable_steps: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.90 or later
Type `/powerup` in the Claude Code interface
Follow the interactive lessons and animated demos to learn features

stories.headline: Use @-mentions to give Claude Code precise file context
stories.summary: Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code, recommends using @-mentions to point Claude at specific files instead of letting it search. This dramatically reduces token usage and improves accuracy since Claude works with the exact files you intend rather than guessing from project structure.
actionable_steps: Type @ in Claude Code to see a file picker with fuzzy search
Select the specific files relevant to your task before writing your prompt
Combine multiple @-mentions for cross-file tasks like refactoring

stories.headline: Use defer permission in PreToolUse hooks to pause headless sessions
stories.summary: You can now pause headless Claude Code sessions at tool calls and resume them later with permission evaluation. This allows for better control over automated workflows that need human approval.
actionable_steps: Set up a PreToolUse hook in your Claude Code configuration
Return 'defer' as the permission decision in the hook
The hook will re-evaluate the tool call upon resumption

stories.headline: Configure streaming timeout for better connection handling
stories.summary: The new CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS environment variable lets you customize how long Claude Code waits before timing out idle streaming connections. This helps prevent unnecessary disconnections during long-running operations.
actionable_steps: Choose a timeout value in milliseconds (default is 90000 for 90 seconds)
Restart Claude Code for the setting to take effect

stories.headline: Write a CLAUDE.md file to set project conventions once
stories.summary: Adding a CLAUDE.md to your project root lets you define coding standards, test commands, and architectural decisions that persist across every Claude Code session. Think of it as onboarding documentation that Claude reads automatically — you teach it once instead of repeating yourself.
actionable_steps: Create a CLAUDE.md in your project root with build/test/lint commands
Add coding conventions like naming patterns, preferred libraries, and file structure
Include architectural decisions and constraints Claude should respect
Use /init in Claude Code to auto-generate a starter CLAUDE.md
